lines.lyric_translation: Woah eyo woah oh oh / Woah eyo woah oh oh / Woah eyo woah oh oh
Woah eyo woah / Woah eyo woah / Woah eyo woah

lines.lyric_hangul: 잠시 넘어졌지 괜찮아 잡아줄게 너 많이 걱정했니
lines.lyric_translation: You fell down, it’s alright, I’ll pick you up / Did you worry a lot?
No no no, it’s your first time

lines.lyric: Geugeotjjeumeun da gwaenchana da geureon geoji
lines.lyric_hangul: 그것쯤은 다 괜찮아 다 그런 거지
lines.lyric_translation: That’s ok, everyone does that

lines.lyric: Wollae geurae da eoreundeuldo uri nai ttaen
lines.lyric_hangul: 원래 그래 다 어른들도 우리 나이 땐
lines.lyric_translation: That’s how it is, even adults made mistakes
Practiced and grew when they were our age
There’s still so many firsts for us

lines.lyric: Gwaenchana urido gyeokkeobomyeo keumyeon dwejana uljima
lines.lyric_hangul: 괜찮아 우리도 겪어보며 크면 되잖아 울지마
lines.lyric_translation: It’s alright, we just need to go through it and grow, don’t cry
If you fall back a little, just rest

lines.lyric: Neoneun jal hago isseo neo jamshi himdeul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 너는 잘 하고 있어 너 잠시 힘들 때
lines.lyric_translation: You’re doing fine, when things are hard
I’ll run with you, don’t worry

lines.lyric: Ireona pareul geoteo ollyeo pogi ttawin jeobeo
lines.lyric_hangul: 일어나 팔을 걷어 올려 포기 따윈 접어
lines.lyric_translation: Get up and roll up your sleeves, don’t give up
You’re doing fine / You’re doing fine
You’re doing fine / You’re doing fine
Have strength, just endure a little more / Have strength, just endure a little more
I’ll be next to you / I’ll be next to you
You’re doing fine / You’re doing fine
You’re doing fine / You’re doing fine

lines.lyric: You gotta take your time hal su itjana
lines.lyric_hangul: You gotta take your time 할 수 있잖아
lines.lyric_translation: You gotta take your time, you can do it / You gotta take your time, you can do it
You can do just fine / You can do just fine
Should I stop or not? Should I give up or not?
Why can’t I?
Throw away all these thoughts
In that time, just run

lines.lyric: Eodiga kkeuchinjido moreun chae dallineun neukkim
lines.lyric_hangul: 어디가 끝인지도 모른 채 달리는 느낌
lines.lyric_translation: Feels like you’re running without knowing where the end is

lines.lyric_hangul: 지친 몸과 마음의 연속 그러다 포기 앞에 들킴
lines.lyric_translation: It’s a cycle of having a tired body and tired heart / You’re about to give up

lines.lyric_hangul: 끝은 네가 정하는 거야 네가 정한 끝은 뭐야
lines.lyric_translation: But you’re the one who decides the end / What’s your decision?

lines.lyric: Kkumeul hyanghae dallyeoganeun neoye moseub geu jachega
lines.lyric_hangul: 꿈을 향해 달려가는 너의 모습 그 자체가
lines.lyric_translation: Just the fact that you’re running toward the end

lines.lyric_hangul: 충분히 잘 하고 있어 넌 분명 잘 하고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: You’re doing enough / You’re doing just fine

lines.lyric: Naega aneun neoye moseub bunmyeong chweseoneul dahago isseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 내가 아는 너의 모습 분명 최선을 다하고 있어
lines.lyric_translation: I know you and you’re trying your best right now

lines.lyric_hangul: 그거면 됐어 그렇게 계속 너만의 pace를 유지해가
lines.lyric_translation: That’s all you need / Just keep your pace

lines.lyric: Buranhaehaji malgo neo jashineul jashinhago uijihaebwa
lines.lyric_hangul: 불안해하지 말고 너 자신을 자신하고 의지해봐
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t be nervous, trust yourself
You’re doing fine
You’re doing fine
Have strength, just endure a little more
I’ll be next to you
You’re doing fine
You’re doing fine

lines.lyric: You gotta take your time hal su itjana
lines.lyric_hangul: You gotta take your time 할 수 있잖아
lines.lyric_translation: You gotta take your time, you can do it
You can do just fine
Even if it’s hard and tiring, don’t give up

lines.lyric: Neol milchyeo naeji ma neon jogeum seotun geot ppunya
lines.lyric_hangul: 널 밀쳐 내지 마 넌 조금 서툰 것 뿐야
lines.lyric_translation: Don’t push yourself away, you just need time

lines.lyric: Shigani jina tto jina neol dorabwasseul ttae
lines.lyric_hangul: 시간이 지나 또 지나 널 돌아봤을 때
lines.lyric_translation: Afterwards, when you look back
Tell yourself this
